In detail

Cornigliano and Sestri Ponente, the old steel and aviation quarters along the western waterfront, with the airport at their edge. Via Cornigliano is a named priority area in the Comune's 2026 plan, reinforced anti-degrado patrols were announced for both Cornigliano and Sestri Ponente, and Cornigliano featured in the July 2026 anti-dealing operation that identified 75 people alongside the Maddalena. Visitors pass through for the airport rather than stay.
